answers.notes: Claim c23 of ch04-union-territories.json states verbatim that Leh serves as the capital of the UT of Ladakh. The distractors are excluded by the claims: Kargil is only the other district (c23), while Srinagar and Jammu are the summer/winter capitals of Jammu and Kashmir, not Ladakh (c29).
answers.quote: The UT of Ladakh consists of two districts, Leh and Kargil, with Leh serving as the capital.
